Title: Relates to residency requirements for clerk in the village of Alden, county of Erie
Summary: Authorizes the village clerk of the village of Alden, county of Erie, to reside outside of such village, providing such residency is in an adjoining county.
LawCode: Amd §3-300, Vil L; amd §3, Pub Off L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the village law and the public officers law, in relation to residency requirements for clerk in the village of Alden, county of Erie
